rules.rule: Bank of Korea figure for 2025 per-capita GNI, first (preliminary) release on 2026-03-10: KRW 52,416,000 (5,241.6만원), USD 36,855, up 4.6% in won.
rules.conditions: This is the statistic itself; see the next rule for when KIS applies it.
rules.source: BOK press release '2025년 4/4분기 및 연간 국민소득(잠정)', 2026-03-10 (bok.or.kr B0000170 nttId=10096884; KDI EIEC mirror eiec.kdi.re.kr materialView num=277800; BOK PDF mirrored at socialkorea.org '국민소득통계 2026년 3월 10일 공보 2026-03-09호'). Seen through WebSearch extracts only; WebFetch could not resolve any host.
rules.quote: 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)은 5,241.6만원(미 달러화 기준 36,855달러)으로 전년대비 4.6% 증가

rules.rule: KIS applies the 2025 GNI of KRW 52,416,000 to every status with a GNI-based requirement, for applications filed from 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31. E-7 is the one exception (separate rule).
rules.conditions: Application filed between 2026-04-01 and 2027-03-31, for any GNI-based requirement other than E-7.
rules.effect: Replaces the previous KRW 49,955,000 baseline from 2026-04-01.
rules.source: HiKorea notice (March 2026) '2025년 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 적용 기준 안내', reproduced verbatim by migrant-worker counselling centres: https://www.scfw.or.kr/bbs/board.php?bo_table=sub2_3&wr_id=11 and https://www.gnscfw.org/1303; also EKW 동포세계신문 https://www.ekw.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=20273. I did not see the hikorea.go.kr original.
rules.quote: ○ (적용 GNI) 5,241.6만원 ○ (적용기간) '26.4.1.~'27.3.31. ○ (적용대상) GNI 기준을 요건으로 하는 모든 체류자격

rules.rule: When KIS switches GNI figures: it uses the BOK's FIRST (March) release of the previous year's per-capita GNI. That figure applies from the first day of the month after the BOK announcement until March of the following year. Later BOK revisions are not adopted. If the previous year's GNI has not yet been announced on the application date, the GNI of the year before that applies.
rules.amount: Switch date 2026-04-01 (BOK release 2026-03-10). Next switch about 2027-04-01, after the BOK's March 2027 release of 2026 GNI.
rules.conditions: Every GNI-based requirement.
rules.effect: An application filed on or before 2026-03-31 is tested against KRW 49,955,000. One filed on or after 2026-04-01 is tested against KRW 52,416,000 (E-7 excepted).
rules.source: HiKorea notice of 2025-03-20 ('2025년 4월1일부터 2026년 3월 31일까지 적용되는 2024년 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 적용 기준 알림'), reproduced at http://inkoreabiz.com/bbs/board.php?bo_table=notice&wr_id=50 and by EKW. The 2026 notice repeats the same April-to-March window.
rules.quote: 전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)은 한국은행이 전년도 1인당 GNI를 최초 발표하는 3월 수치를 기준으로 발표되는 날의 다음달 첫째 날부터 적용하여 다음 연도 3월까지 적용 / 신청일기준전년도GNI가발표되지않았을경우전전년도기준적용

rules.rule: The previous baseline was the 2024 GNI of KRW 49,955,000 (4,995.5만원, USD 36,624; BOK release of 2025-03-05). It applied to applications filed from 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31.
rules.conditions: Application filed between 2025-04-01 and 2026-03-31.
rules.source: BOK '2024년 4/4분기 및 연간 국민소득(잠정)' (bok.or.kr nttId=10090110); HiKorea notice of 2025-03-20 as reproduced at inkoreabiz.com wr_id=50.
rules.quote: 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)은 4,995.5만원으로 전년대비 5.7% 증가 (미 달러화 기준 36,624달러)

rules.rule: On 2026-06-09 the BOK revised 2025 per-capita GNI to KRW 52,570,000 (5,257.0만원, USD 36,963) in '2024년 국민계정(확정) 및 2025년 국민계정(잠정)'. Under the switch rule KIS does not adopt this revision. Pages that quote 52.57M (for example koreaworkexpert.com) are wrong for immigration purposes.
rules.amount: KRW 52,570,000 (not used by KIS). If someone wrongly uses it: 2x = 105,140,000; 3x = 157,710,000.
rules.conditions: n/a
rules.effect: None: the KIS baseline stays at KRW 52,416,000 until 2027-03-31.
rules.source: BOK press release (bok.or.kr B0000501 nttId=10098382; KDI EIEC num=282377); FN News 2026-06-09. The statement that KIS ignores revisions rests on the HiKorea switch rule ('최초 발표하는 3월 수치').

rules.rule: Exception for E-7: GNI-based E-7 requirements keep using the 2024 GNI of 4,995만원 (KRW 49,955,000) until March 2027, pending a separate employment-visa wage system announced for the second half of 2026. Affected rules: the E-7-S1 3x income test, the ministry-recommendation 1.5x waiver, and the D-10-3 to E-7 1x wage.
rules.amount: KRW 49,955,000 (labelled 4,995만원) for E-7 GNI-based tests until 2027-03
rules.conditions: The requirement belongs to the E-7 status: an E-7 issue, change or extension.
rules.effect: E-7 multiples are about 4.7% lower than for other statuses: 3x = 149,865,000 instead of 157,248,000.
rules.source: Same HiKorea March 2026 notice, as reproduced at scfw.or.kr wr_id=11 and gnscfw.org/1303. koreaworkexpert.com says it retracted an earlier report of this exception and cites a 2026-07-09 MOJ guide using 52.57M x 3. I could not verify that claim.
rules.quote: (적용특례) 특정활동(E-7) 자격에 한해 '24년 기준인 4,995만원 적용(~'27. 3.까지) … 별도 취업비자 임금체계 마련 시 새로운 임금기준 적용('26.하반기 안내 예정)

rules.rule: KRW amounts of each GNI multiple for applications filed 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31 (all statuses except E-7). KIS publishes only the base figure. I found no KIS table of multiples, so these are computed from the base.
rules.conditions: Application filed 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31; not an E-7 requirement.
rules.source: Computed from the HiKorea 2026 base of 5,241.6만원. Private guides quote the same 2x figure (1억 483만 2,000원), e.g. EKW idxno=20273.
rules.quote: (적용 GNI) 5,241.6만원

rules.rule: KRW amounts of each GNI multiple under the E-7 exception (2024 GNI), valid until 2027-03. The same table applied to every status for applications filed 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31.
rules.conditions: E-7 GNI-based tests until 2027-03; any status for applications filed 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31.
rules.source: Computed. The 3x figure of 149,865,000 is quoted by several E-7 guides (search extracts); the 0.7x figure appears in Busan 공고 제2025-1046호.

rules.rule: 2026 wage floor for E-7-1 (professionals) is a fixed annual amount set by MOJ notice, not a GNI percentage: KRW 31,120,000 a year. It applies from 2026-02-01 to 2026-12-31; the old floor applied until 2026-01-31. An occupation with its own wage rule follows that rule instead.
rules.conditions: E-7-1 issue, change or extension
rules.stacks: An occupation with a separate wage rule set by MOJ overrides this floor.
rules.source: 법무부 공고 제2025-406호 '2026년 특정활동(E-7) 체류자격 임금요건 기준 공고' (2025-12-29), https://www.immigration.go.kr/bbs/immigration/211/488810/download.do ; https://www.moj.go.kr/bbs/moj/184/601893/artclView.do ; also quoted in MOJ '2030 이민정책 미래전략' (2026.3).
rules.quote: 전문인력(E-7-1) 연 3,112만원 이상 … 2026. 2. 1.부터 2026. 12. 31.까지 … 2026. 1. 31.까지는 기존 임금요건 기준 적용 … 법무부 장관이 국민 일자리 보호 등을 위해 임금요건 기준을 달리 정한 직종은 해당 기준에 따름

rules.rule: 2026 wage floor for E-7-2 (semi-professionals): KRW 25,890,000 a year.
rules.conditions: E-7-2 issue, change or extension
rules.stacks: An occupation-specific MOJ wage rule overrides this floor.
rules.source: 법무부 공고 제2025-406호 (as above)
rules.quote: 준전문인력(E-7-2) 연 2,589만원 이상

rules.rule: 2026 wage floor for E-7-3 (general skilled workers): KRW 25,890,000 a year.
rules.conditions: E-7-3 issue, change or extension
rules.stacks: An occupation-specific MOJ wage rule overrides this floor.
rules.source: 법무부 공고 제2025-406호 (as above)
rules.quote: 일반기능인력(E-7-3) 연 2,589만원 이상

rules.rule: 2026 wage floor for E-7-4 (points-based skilled workers): KRW 26,000,000 a year, unchanged from 2025. The KIS change document list asks for an E-7-4 contract of at least 2 years and at least KRW 26M a year.
rules.conditions: E-7-4 (and E-7-4R) issue, change or extension
rules.source: 법무부 공고 제2025-406호; data/visadocs.yaml line 8814 (manual-derived): 'Submit the E-7-4 contract (≥ 2 yrs, ≥ KRW 26M/yr)'
rules.quote: 숙련기능인력(E-7-4) 연 2,600만원 이상

rules.rule: History of the reduced floors. Before 2025-04-01 the E-7-1 floor was 80% of the previous year's GNI, lowered to 70% for SMEs, venture companies and mid-sized firms outside the capital region. 법무부 공고 제2025-106호 (2025-03-20, effective 2025-04-01) replaced this with one fixed amount for every company (2025: E-7-1 28.67M; E-7-2/E-7-3 25.15M; E-7-4 26M). I found no 70% reduced E-7 floor in the 2026 notice.
rules.amount: Abolished: 80% GNI (2024 base 47,248,000 gave 37,798,400) and 70% GNI for SMEs (33,073,600). Now fixed: KRW 31.12M (2026).
rules.conditions: Pre-2025 rule: an SME, venture company or non-capital-region mid-sized company hiring a Korean-university graduate (D-2/D-10) on E-7-1.
rules.effect: Formerly lowered the floor from 80% to 70% of GNI. No longer applies.
rules.source: 중소벤처기업부 공고 제2024-561호 (kbiz.or.kr PDF) for the old 80%/70% rule; kowork.kr/blog/e7-visa-2025-salary-requirements, ansan.yspc.kr wr_id=285 and hanvisa.net for 공고 제2025-106호 (leads). One private guide (search extract) still claims a 70% SME floor in 2026; the 2026 notice table reportedly has no such line.
rules.quote: 전년도 국민 1인당 GNI의 80% 이상 … 중소·벤처·비수도권중견기업 특례 해당시 'GNI 70% 이상' (2024 공고) / 기존 GNI 80% 및 중소기업 70% 기준이 폐지되고, 모든 기업에 동일한 연봉 기준이 적용됩니다 (kowork, lead)

rules.rule: My own derivation: the E-7-2/E-7-3 floors equal the annual statutory minimum wage. 2026: 10,320 won x 209 h x 12 = 25,882,560, about 2,589만원. 2025: 10,030 x 209 x 12 = 25,155,240, about 2,515만원. So these floors follow the minimum wage, not GNI, and the 2027 notice will move with the 2027 minimum wage. The E-7-1 floor (31.12M) is about 1.2x the minimum wage in 2026 and about 1.14x in 2025, so it has no fixed formula.
rules.source: Arithmetic against 법무부 공고 제2025-406호 / 제2025-106호 and the 2026 minimum wage (10,320원/h, 고용노동부 고시)
rules.quote: 준전문인력(E-7-2) 연 2,589만원 이상 / 일반기능인력(E-7-3) 연 2,589만원 이상

rules.rule: Education and experience requirements are waived when the employer has an employment recommendation from the relevant central ministry (or a metropolitan or provincial head) and the annual pay is at least 1.5x the previous year's GNI.
rules.amount: 1.5x GNI. Under the E-7 exception: KRW 74,932,500 (until 2027-03). If the standard 2026 GNI applied: KRW 78,624,000.
rules.conditions: Ministry or local-government recommendation AND pay of at least 1.5x GNI
rules.effect: Waives the degree and experience routes (master's / bachelor's + 1 yr / 5 yrs); the wage floor still applies.
rules.source: Leads only: visainfo-korea.com E-7 학력·경력 요건 가이드 (2026); yoonhjs.com E-7 기본자격요건 uid=253 (search extracts). Not seen in a primary text.
rules.quote: 연간보수가 GNI의 1.5배 이상이고 중앙행정기관장 및 지방자치단체장(특별시장, 광역시장 포함)의 추천을 받는 경우 학력, 경력 모두 면제

rules.rule: High-income professional (negative-list route): income of at least 3x the previous year's GNI. Any occupation qualifies except simple labour, jobs contrary to public morals or jobs otherwise closed to foreigners. No degree or experience requirement.
rules.amount: 3x GNI. Under the E-7 exception: KRW 149,865,000 (until 2027-03; several guides quote this figure). If the standard 2026 GNI applied: KRW 157,248,000.
rules.conditions: Job outside the excluded occupations; income of at least 3x GNI
rules.effect: Waives education, experience and the occupation list
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 E-7 우수인재/네거티브 방식, quoted verbatim in visa-map-audit/findings.md line 873 (earlier research; not re-verified by me). KRW amounts from guides (search extracts, e.g. visalovekorea.com/E-7, immikorea E-7-S).
rules.quote: 소득이 전년도 1인당 국민총소득의 3배 이상이면서 단순노무, 선량한 풍속에 반하는 업종, 기타 외국인의 취업을 제한하는 직종에 취업하지 않으면

rules.rule: D-10-3 to E-7: after 1+ year as a high-tech intern (D-10-3), a person formally hired in the field of the internship at a wage of at least 1x the previous year's GNI has the E-7 education and experience requirements waived.
rules.amount: 1x GNI. Under the E-7 exception: KRW 49,955,000 (until 2027-03); 52,416,000 if the standard figure applied. Either way it is far above the ordinary 31.12M floor.
rules.conditions: 1+ year of D-10-3 internship; formal employment in the internship field; wage of at least GNI
rules.effect: Waives the education and experience requirements
rules.source: 사증발급/체류 안내매뉴얼 구직(D-10) › 첨단기술인턴 체류지원 특례 (pp.158-), quoted in visa-map-audit/findings.md line 215
rules.quote: (취업 지원) 첨단기술인턴(D-10-3) 자격으로 국내 기업 등에서 1년 이상 인턴활동을 한 자로서, 인턴 활동 분야에 정식 취업하고, 임금이 전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 이상일 경우, 특정활동(E-7) 체류자격변경 시 학력, 경력 요건 면제

rules.rule: General PR after 5 years (from D-7 to E-7 or F-2): annual income of at least 2x the previous year's per-capita GNI. Assets are an alternative (next rule).
rules.whose: Probably the applicant plus household members living together (생계를 같이하는 가족), with the applicant's own share at least 50% (see the ALL-F5 rule). Unconfirmed for F-5-1 in particular.
rules.conditions: Income of the year before the application, proved by the tax office's 소득금액증명
rules.stacks: Either income or assets is enough.
rules.source: 서울행정법원 2024. 7. 12. 선고 2022구단72871 판결 (casenote.kr; lawhome.or.kr PDF), which quotes the MOJ criteria; leads: publicvisa.kr idx=17269739, haniseoul.com F-5-1 guide
rules.quote: 일반 거주(F-2) 체류자에게는 국내 체류기간 5년 이상 이외에도 생계유지능력으로 '전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 2배 이상 또는 전년도 가계 평균 순자산 1.5배 이상'을 요구

rules.rule: Asset alternative for F-5-1: net assets (assets minus debts) of at least 1.5x the average household net assets in the 가계금융복지조사 (national household finance survey) published the previous year.
rules.whose: household: applicant and family living together
rules.conditions: Assets held for some period before the application (6+ months according to leads)
rules.stacks: Either income or assets is enough.
rules.source: 2022구단72871 judgment (as above); 국가데이터처/한국은행/금융감독원 '2025년 가계금융복지조사 결과' (2025-12-04, mods.go.kr list_no=439535; korea.kr newsId=156733178)
rules.quote: 전년도 가계 평균 순자산 1.5배 이상 / 2025년 3월말 기준 가구의 평균 자산은 5억 6,678만원, 부채는 9,534만원으로 순자산은 4억 7,144만원

rules.rule: The asset baseline is the 가계금융복지조사 (joint survey of Statistics Korea/국가데이터처, BOK and FSS) average net assets PER HOUSEHOLD, as of March 31 of the survey year, published each December. KIS uses the result 'published the previous year'. For applications in 2026 that is the 2025 survey (published 2025-12-04).
rules.amount: Average household net assets: KRW 471,440,000 (2025 survey). 1x = 471,440,000; 1.5x = 707,160,000. Previous (2024 survey, from memory and consistent with the reported +5.0%): KRW 448,940,000.
rules.conditions: Routes with an asset alternative
rules.source: Survey: mods.go.kr board list_no=439535; @MODS_korea post of 2025-12-04; newsis NISX20251204_0003428382. Wording of the KIS rule: yoonhjs.com F5 기본공통요건2 uid=427 (lead quoting the manual).
rules.quote: 신청인 또는 생계를 같이하는 가족이 보유하고 있는 금융자산과 실물자산의 가계 순자산(부채 제외)의 합계가 통계청 발표 전년도 가계금융복지조사 결과 평균 순자산 이상

rules.rule: Where income or assets can be combined across the household (본인 또는 생계를 같이하는 가족), the applicant's own income or assets must be at least 50% of the threshold.
rules.amount: Own share at least 50% of the required amount (e.g. own income of at least KRW 26,208,000 for a 1x GNI route)
rules.whose: household with own share at least 50%
rules.conditions: Routes that allow household income or assets (F-5-2, F-5-6 and the general F-5 livelihood rule)
rules.effect: Limits how much a spouse's income can carry the application
rules.source: Manual-derived case in data/visadocs.yaml line 12041 (F-5-6: 'combined household income: own share >= 50%'), from 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36. 외국국적동포 › F-5-6; yoonhjs.com uid=427 (lead)
rules.quote: 다만, 신청자 본인의 소득 또는 자산이 기준액의 50% 이상이여야 함.

rules.rule: Marriage migrant PR: the household (applicant plus family living together) needs income of at least 1x per-capita GNI, OR household net assets at least at the median level.
rules.amount: Income: KRW 52,416,000 (from 2026-04-01). Assets: at least the median household net assets of the 가계금융복지조사; the 2025-survey median was not found (private estimates KRW 240-260M).
rules.conditions: 2+ years on F-6 and one of the three F-6 cases (living together, raising a child, marriage ended without fault)
rules.stacks: Either income or assets is enough.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 체류자격 변경허가 › 2. 결혼이민자(F-5-2), 국민의 미성년 자녀(F-5-3) › 2) 제출 서류, transcribed in data/visadocs.yaml lines 11632-11708
rules.quote: (일인당 국민총소득 이상의 소득금액) / (중위수준 이상의 가계 자산)

rules.rule: Recognised-refugee PR: 2+ years of stay, and income of at least 1x GNI or household assets at least at the median level. This is a relaxed version of the general rule.
rules.amount: KRW 52,416,000 or median household net assets
rules.conditions: Recognised refugee (F-2-4) for 2+ years
rules.effect: Lower than the general 2x GNI / 1.5x average net assets
rules.stacks: Either income or assets is enough. Per the court, the criteria cannot be applied mechanically to refugees.
rules.source: 서울행정법원 2022구단72871 (2024-07-12) judgment summary (casenote.kr)
rules.quote: 난민인정자에게는 국내 체류 2년 이상과 GNI 이상 또는 가계 자산 중위수준 이상을 요구

rules.rule: Overseas Korean (F-4, 2+ years) PR: the standard test is income of at least 1x GNI. Household income may be combined if the applicant's own share is at least 50%.
rules.whose: household with own share at least 50%
rules.conditions: 2+ years on F-4
rules.stacks: Lowered by the reductions below. Several non-income alternatives exist.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36. 외국국적동포 관련 › 5. 외국국적동포 영주자격(F-5) 부여 세부절차 (data/visadocs.yaml line 12041); EKW idxno=20335 (MOJ Q&A)
rules.quote: 통상 영주권 신청 시 전년도 1인당 GNI 이상의 소득을 충족해야

rules.rule: Volunteering reduction: with a set record of volunteering (100+ hours over 6+ months, per the manual-derived note), the income test drops to 80% of GNI.
rules.whose: household with own share at least 50%
rules.conditions: Volunteer record certificate (자원봉사 실적, 100+ h over 6+ months)
rules.stacks: Does not add to the Korean-proficiency cut. Both together give a separate 60% tier, not 0.8 x 0.7.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36 › F-5-6 대상별 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml line 12058); EKW idxno=20335
rules.quote: 일정 기간의 자원봉사 실적*이 있는 경우 GNI 80% 이상인 경우 인정

rules.rule: Korean-proficiency reduction (동포 체류자격 통합, effective 2026-02-12): an overseas Korean who completed KIIP level 5, graduated from a Korean primary/middle/high school, or holds a Korean bachelor's degree or higher needs income of 70% of GNI.
rules.whose: household with own share at least 50%
rules.conditions: Counts as 한국어 우수자: KIIP 5, Korean school graduate, or Korean degree
rules.stacks: Combined with volunteering, it gives the 60% tier.
rules.source: Leads: visatokorea.kr 영주권_귀화신청 page; EKW idxno=20200 / 20335 (70% given only as a worked example). Not in the 2026.9.18 manual text transcribed in visadocs (that section is marked partial).
rules.quote: 한국어 우수자는 GNI의 70% 이상 (lead; 행정사 안내 및 EKW 설명회 보도)

rules.rule: Korean proficiency plus volunteering together: the income test drops to 60% of GNI.
rules.whose: household with own share at least 50%
rules.conditions: Both the Korean-proficiency condition and the volunteering record
rules.stacks: 60% is the floor. The cuts are not multiplied (0.8 x 0.7 would be 0.56).
rules.source: EKW 동포세계신문 report of the MOJ 동포체류통합정책 briefing and Q&A, idxno=20200 and 20335 (press report of an MOJ statement)
rules.quote: 한국어 성적이 우수하고 자원봉사활동까지 하게 되면 영주권(F-5) 취득 시 소득기준을 전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI)의 60% 이상으로 대폭 낮춰준다

rules.rule: Asset alternative for F-5-6: property tax paid last year of at least KRW 500,000, OR the applicant's OWN net assets at least equal to the survey's average household net assets.
rules.amount: Property tax at least KRW 500,000; or own net assets at least KRW 471,440,000 (2025 survey)
rules.conditions: Instead of the income test
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36 › F-5-6 case (data/visadocs.yaml line 12065: 'Property tax paid last year >= KRW 500k, or own net assets >= average household net assets'); Korean wording from a lead (wevisakorea / visatokorea search extract)
rules.quote: 본인명의 순자산이 통계청, 금감원, 한국은행이 매년 공동 조사하여 발표하는 전년도 가계금융 복지조사 결과의 평균 순자산 이상을 보유하고 있는 경우도 기본요건 충족으로 봅니다

rules.rule: Other F-5-6 routes that replace the income test: age 60+ with a pension from abroad of at least 1x GNI; head of a company with annual trade of at least KRW 2bn with Korea; investment of USD 500k+; head of a Korean community organisation or company recommended by the head of a Korean mission; meeting the general or simplified naturalization requirements.
rules.amount: Pension at least KRW 52,416,000 a year; trade at least KRW 2,000,000,000; investment at least USD 500,000
rules.conditions: As listed
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 36 › F-5-6 대상별 제출서류 (data/visadocs.yaml lines 12059-12085); EKW idxno=20200
rules.quote: 연간 20억원 이상 교역실적을 보유한 기업 대표 - 미화 50만불 이상을 국내에 투자한 외국인 - 재외공관장의 추천을 받은 동포단체 또는 법인 대표

rules.rule: Pensioner PR: age 60+, with a pension from abroad of at least 2x GNI a year. Only the foreign pension counts. Leads list no asset alternative for F-5-13.
rules.conditions: Age 60+
rules.source: Leads: publicvisa.kr idx=17269739; hanvisa.net F-5 27가지 유형 (search extracts)
rules.quote: 해외로부터 받은 연금액만을 소득으로 인정하고 연간소득요건은 전년도 1인당 GNI 2배 이상

rules.rule: Points-based PR (3+ years on F-2-7): income of 2x GNI or net assets of 1.5x the survey average. The manual's F-5-16 document list includes the asset-route documents ('자산보유 기준').
rules.amount: KRW 104,832,000 or net assets of KRW 707,160,000
rules.whose: household with own share at least 50% (assumed, as for F-5-1)
rules.conditions: 3+ years on F-2-7
rules.stacks: Either income or assets is enough.
rules.source: Leads: publicvisa.kr idx=17269739, haniseoul.com; asset-route documents in 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 32. 영주(F-5) › 공통 서류 (data/visadocs.yaml line 11521)
rules.quote: 전년도 1인당 GNI 2배 이상이거나 전년도 평균 순자산의 1.5배 이상 (F-5-1, F-5-13, F-5-16, F-5-26)

rules.rule: R&D staff of a foreign-invested company (D-8 가목, 3+ years): income of 2x GNI or net assets of 1.5x the survey average.
rules.amount: KRW 104,832,000 or net assets of KRW 707,160,000
rules.whose: household with own share at least 50% (assumed)
rules.conditions: 3+ years as essential R&D staff on D-8-1; bachelor's degree
rules.stacks: Either income or assets is enough.

rules.quote: 소득 : 전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 2배 이상 / 자산 전년도 평균 순자산 1.5배 이상

rules.rule: Which year's income and what proof: the income of the year before the application, shown on the tax office's 소득금액증명. If that certificate cannot be issued yet on the application date (e.g. before the year's tax filing), the applicant submits all three of: wage-withholding receipt, bank records of the salary, and a pledge by employer and applicant. Some guidance instead lets the income of the year before that be used. The decision may be held until official proof is filed.
rules.conditions: Every income-based F-2/F-5 test
rules.effect: Income year and GNI year can differ. In early 2026 the 2025 income is compared with the 2024 GNI (49,955,000) until 2026-03-31.
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 (data/visadocs.yaml lines 10513-10519, 12048-12055); EKW idxno=20273 (lead) on the income year
rules.quote: 신청일 당시 소득금액증명원 제출이 불가한 경우 (㉠~㉢ 모두 제출) / 영주자격 변경 신청일 당시 소득금액증명 등 공적 서류 발급이 불가능할 경우

rules.rule: Other long-term resident (5+ years): the applicant's OWN income of the previous year must be at least KRW 40,000,000 (a fixed amount, not GNI; the spouse's income is not added), AND own assets of at least KRW 20,000,000 in financial assets held 6+ months. Both are required.
rules.amount: Own income at least KRW 40,000,000; own financial assets at least KRW 20,000,000 (held 6+ months)
rules.conditions: 5+ years on an eligible status; KIIP 4
rules.stacks: Both required (not either-or). Leads say the amount is reset each December for the following year.
rules.source: Leads: yoonhjs.com uid=444 '기타장기체류자(F2-99) 변경허가 (2025.9.9 메뉴얼 업데이트 반영)'; haniseoul.com F-2 guide. The manual's F-2-99 change list (data/visadocs.yaml lines 10497-10531) confirms that asset and income evidence is required but gives no amounts.
rules.quote: 신청인 본인이 소유한 자산이 2,000만원 이상일 것 / 전년도 소득 기준 4,000만원 이상 (lead)

rules.rule: The F-2-7 requirement of 3 years' continuous lawful stay on the current status is waived for applicants whose annual income is at least KRW 40,000,000 (only if they file a 소득금액증명).
rules.conditions: Must file a tax-office 소득금액증명
rules.source: Leads: visainfo-korea.com F-2-7 guide (2026), hanvisakorea.com 2026/06 F-2-7 (search extracts)
rules.quote: 아래 중 하나에 해당하는 경우 체류기간 요건(3년) 면제 ... 연간 소득금액이 4천만 원 이상인 자(소득금액증명 제출자에 한함)

rules.rule: Regional talent: the income test is at least 70% of the previous year's GNI (an alternative to the Korean-associate-degree route).
rules.amount: 0.7x GNI = KRW 36,691,200 for applications from 2026-04-01 (KRW 34,968,500 before)
rules.conditions: Local-government recommendation; residence and work in a designated depopulating area
rules.source: 부산광역시 공고 제2025-1046호 <지역특화형 비자 사업> 지역우수인재 추천서 발급 대상 모집 공고 (uni.dongseo.ac.kr mirror)
rules.quote: 소득요건: 신청일 기준 전년도 1인당 국민총소득(GNI) 70% 이상 … 1인당 국민총소득(GNi) 70% = 49,955,000원 × 70% = 34,968,500원('24년 기준)

rules.rule: Top-Tier F-2 by change of status: someone employed 1+ year in a high-tech field on D-7 to E-7 or F-2, who meets all Top-Tier criteria except income, must keep income of at least 2x GNI and have a central-ministry recommendation. The Top-Tier main criteria (direct route) need income of at least 3x GNI.
rules.amount: 2x GNI = KRW 104,832,000 (change route); 3x GNI = KRW 157,248,000 (main criteria). If the E-7 exception applies to an E-7-T holder: 99,910,000 / 149,865,000.
rules.conditions: As stated
rules.source: Top-Tier manual and 법무부고시 제2026-160호, quoted in visa-map-audit/findings.md lines 881 and 1133 (earlier research, not re-verified by me)
rules.quote: 주재(D-7) ~ 특정활동(E-7) 또는 거주(F-2) 자격으로 1년 이상 첨단분야에 취업한 사람 중 소득요건을 제외한 최우수인재 자격 기준을 모두 충족한 사람으로서, 1인당 GNI 2배 이상 소득을 유지하고, 관계 중앙행정기관의 추천을 받은 자

rules.rule: The spouse or minor child of an F-2-7 holder gets F-2-71 only when the F-2-7 holder's annual income is at least the latest per-capita GNI. Below that, the family member is handled as F-1 (방문동거) instead.
rules.conditions: Family member of an F-2-7 holder
rules.effect: Below GNI: F-1 instead of F-2-71
rules.source: 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 › 29. 방문동거(F-1) › 체류기간 연장허가 › 11. 점수제 우수인재(F-2-7)의 배우자 또는 미성년자녀 (data/visadocs.yaml line 9446)
rules.quote: 점수제 우수인재(F-2-7)의 배우자 또는 미성년자녀 (case: F-2-7 holder whose annual income is below the latest per-capita GNI)

rules.rule: Spouse or minor child of an F-5 holder: the inviting F-5 holder needs income of at least 1x GNI, or 70% of GNI when the household (including the inviter) has at most 3 people.
rules.amount: KRW 52,416,000; or KRW 36,691,200 for a household of 3 or fewer
rules.conditions: Household size at most 3 for the 70% tier
rules.source: Leads only (allvisakorea.com F-2-3 post, 2023-based; immikorea F-2-3), search extracts
rules.quote: 본인포함 직계 동거가족의 수가 3인 이하일 경우, GNI 70% 이상이면 인정 (lead)

openQuestions: Did the July 2026 revision of the KIS stay manual end the E-7 GNI exception? The HiKorea March 2026 notice keeps E-7 on the 2024 GNI of 4,995만원 until 2027-03 and promises a new employment-visa wage system in 2026 H2. koreaworkexpert.com retracted that and cites a 2026-07-09 MOJ guide using 52.57M x 3 = 157.71M for E-7-S1. I could not verify either way; WebFetch failed on every host and the shared search budget ran out.
Is the E-7 exception amount exactly KRW 49,955,000 (4,995.5만원) or KRW 49,950,000 (the notice writes 4,995만원)? This decides whether E-7-S1 3x is 149,865,000 or 149,850,000.

Does the E-7 exception also govern moves OUT of E-7 that carry a GNI test (E-7-T to F-2-T 2x GNI; E-7-S1/S2 to F-2-7; E-7 to F-5-1 2x GNI)? Logically those are F-2/F-5 requirements on the standard KRW 52,416,000, but no source says so.

What is the median household net assets ('중위수준 이상의 가계 자산') figure KIS applies for F-5-2 and F-5-27 in 2026? The 2025 가계금융복지조사 headline gives only the average (KRW 471.44M). Private estimates of the median are KRW 238-260M. The official value is in the survey's appendix tables (KOSIS) and could not be fetched.

Which survey year applies, and when does KIS switch: on the December publication, on 1 January, or with the April GNI switch? The rule says '통계청 발표 전년도 가계금융복지조사', so for 2026 applications that is presumably the 2025 survey (published 2025-12-04). The 2024 survey average of KRW 448.94M is from memory; it is consistent with the reported +5.0% growth.
For F-5-1 and F-5-16, is the 2x GNI income the applicant's own income or household income with own share at least 50%? Leads disagree. The court judgment says only 'GNI 2배 이상 또는 가계 평균 순자산 1.5배'.

Do F-5-4, F-5-9, F-5-15, F-5-18, F-5-28 and F-5-29 accept an asset alternative, and is it average or median? The manual's document lists for all of them include the asset-route documents ('자산보유 기준'), but the data mentions assets only for F-5-28 ('average assets').

The F-5-6 70% Korean-proficiency tier is documented only by an administrative-agent page and an EKW example. The 80% volunteering tier is in the 2026.9.18 manual. The 60% combined tier is from the EKW report of the MOJ briefing. The exact definition of 한국어 우수자 needs the MOJ text.

Is there still any reduced E-7-1 wage floor (70% GNI for SMEs, ventures and non-capital-region mid-sized firms, or for Korean-graduate first hires) in 2026? Most sources say 공고 제2025-106호 abolished it from 2025-04-01. One 2026 guide still lists it.

The ministry-recommendation waiver (E-7 education and experience waived at 1.5x GNI) and the E-7-S1 3x wording were found only via guides and earlier research quotes, not in a primary text I could open.

Not verified for lack of search budget: F-6-1 sponsor income of about KRW 25.2M for a couple in 2026 (based on the 기준중위소득, not GNI); F-5-14 and F-5-6R at 70% GNI; F-2-3 at 70% for households of 3 or fewer (lead only, 2023-based); the D-2 to F-2-7 note's '1.5× GNI' track; F-5-T at 3x GNI; the Top-Tier 3x versus 4x GNI question raised in findings.md line 1469.
notes:
Method and limits:
(1) WebFetch failed on every host from this container (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND, even en.wikipedia.org), so all web evidence comes from WebSearch result extracts. Quotes taken from those extracts are close to verbatim but I did not see them on the pages themselves.
(2) The shared WebSearch budget (200 per turn) ran out near the end, so items in openQuestions stay open.
(3) I used data/visadocs.yaml as a primary-derived source: its Korean 'onlyKo' strings are transcribed from 외국인체류 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.18 / 사증발급 안내매뉴얼 2026.9.1.
(4) READ-ONLY respected: nothing in /home/user/blog was modified and no scratch files were written.

Key conclusions for the engine and data (assets/js/visa/rules.js is being written with a single data.gni.krw):
- KIS uses the BOK's FIRST March release, from the 1st of the next month to the following March 31, and ignores later revisions. 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31: KRW 52,416,000. Before that: KRW 49,955,000. Next switch around 2027-04-01. Press reports of Sept 2026 project 2026 GNI near KRW 59M, so 2x would be about KRW 118M from April 2027 (projection only, low confidence). A reader planning F-5 a year or more ahead will face a higher bar.
- A single gni.krw is not enough. E-7 GNI-linked tests (E-7-S1 3x, the 1.5x ministry waiver, D-10-3 to E-7 1x) use KRW 49,955,000 until 2027-03, per the HiKorea notice. Model either a per-status override (gniE7) or a date-keyed table.
- E-7 wage floors are no longer GNI-based. Since 2025-04-01 they are fixed yearly amounts set by MOJ notice. 2026 (from 2026-02-01): E-7-1 31.12M, E-7-2 and E-7-3 25.89M (equal to the annual minimum wage), E-7-4 26.0M. The data's E-7-1 ₩31.1M and E-7-2 ₩25.9M are correct.
- Assets are a household concept: the 가계금융복지조사 average net assets PER HOUSEHOLD, as of March 31. 2025 survey: KRW 471.44M, so 1.5x = KRW 707.16M. F-5-1, F-5-16 and F-5-26 use 1.5x the average. F-5-2 and F-5-27 use the MEDIAN ('중위수준'). F-5-6 uses the applicant's OWN net assets of at least 1x the average, or property tax of at least KRW 500k.
- Reductions do not multiply. F-5-6 has distinct tiers: 80% (volunteering), 70% (Korean proficiency), 60% (both). The rules.js comment 'the largest one that applies counts, never below the floor' fits this if the 60% tier is modelled as its own cut that needs both conditions.
- Two statements in visa-map-audit/findings.md are wrong and should not be carried into fixes: line 214 ('KRW 31.1M = 80% of GNI') and line 873 ('roughly 140M KRW' for 3x GNI).
